verdict.rationale: Resend's own Broadcasts API documents scheduling a send for later, accepting natural language or an ISO 8601 date. That covers the future-delivery half of the story, but only for broadcasts, not transactional sends via the send-email endpoint. Nothing in the pack shows a way to cancel a scheduled email before it goes out. missing for 10: documented scheduling on the transactional send-email endpoint, a cancel/unschedule API for scheduled emails, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can schedule an email for future delivery through the API and cancel it before it goes out

citations.quote: Schedule email to be sent later. The date should be in natural language (e.g.: `in 1 min`) or ISO 8601 format
